title: Observability SLO & Add-on Pricing Matrix: gated packaging experiment
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run an experimentation program to test two alternative packaging models for observability retention, compliance/contract add-ons, and premium SLA gating. Goal is to find a pricing matrix and gating workflow that increases paid conversion for observability upgrades and compliance packs while preserving sales velocity for enterprise deals.
background: Customers frequently ask for longer observability retention and stronger SLAs. Sales and legal require clear contract language and security questionnaire mappings before enabling premium SLAs and compliance bundles. Current offering is a simple add-on price list that lacks gating tied to contract review or questionnaire completion. We need to test whether tighter gating and modular pricing increases ARR without blocking close rates.
success_metrics: Conversion rate from free/standard observability to paid retention tiers (+ target: +6% in Q1)
Incremental MRR from observability & compliance add-ons (+ target: $60k/month after rollout)
Enterprise deal close velocity for contracts requiring premium SLA (no more than 10% increase in average sales cycle)
Support & onboarding hours per sale for gated vs ungated flows (target: <= +2 hours)
Security questionnaire pass-rate after providing compliance pack artifacts (target: 85%)
experiment_variants: Variant A - Modular Ungated: Expose observability retention tiers (30d/90d/365d), compliance pack, and premium SLA as independent add-ons in the console and pricing page. Minimal gating: only billing and subscription checks. Sales ops get informational flag but no enforced contract step.

Variant B - Contract-Gated: Same pricing tiers, but premium SLA and compliance pack require signed contract amendment and completed security questionnaire (automated checklist). Console shows gating state and provides contract + questionnaire templates for self-serve or AE-assisted completion.

Variant C - Bundled Upsell: Offer a bundled enterprise pack (90d retention + compliance artifacts + 99.9% SLA) at a small discount vs a la carte. Bundle requires a short form questionnaire and AE approval for activation.
Control - Current: Existing add-on listing with legacy pricing and no contract automation
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Design & Legal alignment (2 weeks): finalize pricing matrix, questionnaire mapping, contract amendment language, and billing events. Inputs: Legal, Sales Ops, Security.
Phase 1 - Instrumentation & Console UI (3 weeks): implement gating UI, contract templating links, telemetry events, and BF-mode flags. Work with ENG and DES for rollout toggles.

Phase 2 - Small cohort A/B launch (4 weeks): release Variants A/B/C to 15 pilot accounts each (mix of mid-market and enterprise) routed via feature flag. Collect metrics and qualitative feedback from AE and CS.
Phase 3 - Extended trial (6 weeks): expand to 250 accounts across web signups and sales-sourced deals. Monitor conversion, churn, support load, and security questionnaire throughput.
Phase 4 - Analysis + Decision (2 weeks): synthesize results, recommend go/no-go and preferred packaging model. Produce PRD for full release or rollback plan.
acceptance_criteria: Pricing matrix and contract amendment language approved by Legal and Security
Console shows gating status and activation path for gated features for all variants
Telemetry events emitted for funnel steps: pricing page view, add-on click, start questionnaire, questionnaire complete, contract signed, addon activated
A/B experiment framework configured to route accounts deterministically and collect cohort-level metrics
AE and CS runbooks updated with activation checklist for gated flows
open_questions: Should premium SLA pricing be per-tenant fixed fee or % uplift on usage? (Finance input needed)
What is an acceptable delay in sales cycle when a contract amendment is required? (Sales ops target)
Which security questionnaire artifacts are sufficient to mark compliance pack as 'compliance-enabled' for most enterprise buyers?
Do we need to offer temporary trial activation of gated features for evaluation without signed amendment?
risks: Tight gating could lengthen sales cycles and frustrate AEs, reducing close rates
Adding friction may drive customers to competitors who promise immediate activation
Operational load increase for Legal/CS when manual reviews are required
Instrumenting inaccurate telemetry could mislead experiment results
mitigations: Include AE-assisted fast-path where AE can provision a time-limited activation while contract is processed
Provide clear self-serve questionnaire templates and checklist to reduce manual reviews
Limit initial cohort to high-propensity accounts and trial pricing before wider rollout
Engage ENG early for robust telemetry and experiment gating infrastructure
operational_notes: Billing events must map to existing Metering schema to avoid reconciliation gaps
Contract amendments stored in DocStore with association to tenant ID for audit
CS must prepare onboarding playbook for customers migrating retention tiers
Prepare a shared spreadsheet for AE to track questionnaire submissions and timestamps
notes: This ticket focuses on product experiments and packaging; separate implementation tasks will be created under ENG-22101 and DES-1173 for UI and backend work.
Coordinate with partner teams to avoid overlapping add-on promotions in the same timeframe.
